page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instruction blocks. Attach them to an agent and they become part of its prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a named block of instructions an agent follows — a rubric, a house rule, a checklist. Write one, or import a markdown file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.agentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {1 agent} other {# agents}}

delete.title: Delete this skill?
delete.body: {count, plural, =0 {"{name}" is not attached to any agent. Deleting it cannot be undone — its versions go with it.} one {"{name}" is attached to 1 agent, which loses it immediately. Deleting it cannot be undone — its versions go with it.} other {"{name}" is attached to # agents, which lose it immediately. Deleting it cannot be undone — its versions go with it.}}

form.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface — write it as an instruction the agent can act on ("Flag tests that only cover the happy path"), not a label ("test rules").
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that only cover the happy path.
form.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what the agent should look for…
form.createSubtitle: Nothing is saved until you create it

preview.attachHint: Attach this skill to an agent in the agent editor's Skills tab.

detail.loadError: This skill could not be loaded.

versions.diffSubtitle: Removed lines are what v{version} had; added lines are what v{current} has now.
versions.diffIdentical: This version's body is identical to the current one.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.emptyBody: A version is written every time the body changes. Edit the skill in Config and the first snapshot appears here.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Read a markdown file and review it before anything is saved
import.trustNotice: A skill body becomes literal instructions inside the agent's prompt. Importing someone else's skill means running their instructions — read the whole body before you enable it.
import.codeNotice: This file contains code blocks. They are stored and shown as text; nothing in the file is executed.
import.truncatedNotice: The body was longer than the limit and has been truncated.
import.noHeadingNotice: No heading or frontmatter name was found — check the name below.
import.noDescriptionNotice: No description was found — write one below; it is what the agent reads first.
import.disabledHint: The skill will be saved disabled. Enable it on its card once you have reviewed it.
import.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you enable it.
